govdocs-archive_org-nsia-CastilloFernand:
Colonel Fernando Manuel Castillo served the Dominican Republic as its military and air attaché in Washington from 1952 to 1956. This obituary records his death at sixty-two, of a heart ailment.

An attaché's post is part soldier, part diplomat: speaking for a country's armed forces inside another capital's official world. Castillo held his during the Trujillo era, when the Dominican embassy's doings drew close American attention. An obituary squeezes a service life into a few lines; this one is kept as his paper trace here, a single death notice in the files.
